channel.title: The Lowndes Signal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Lowndes Signal (lowndessignal.com)

item.title: Co-ops endorse Allen for lieutenant governor
item.description: Electric Cooperatives of Alabama PAC backs Secretary of State Wes Allen for lieutenant governor, citing his co-op ties, rural focus and record on business rules, spending and election security.

item.title: 483 area code implements Feb. 23
item.description: New 483 area code to overlay Alabama’s 334 region Feb. 23; existing numbers stay the same, while new lines may receive 483.

item.title: Lady Rebels notch another state championship
item.description: Lowndes Academy Lady Rebels edge Southern Academy 40-34 to claim another AISA Class AA girls basketball title, capping their fourth straight trip to the state tournament.

item.title: Bolling Initiative opens college scholarship applications
item.description: Applications are open for TEBI's 2026 $2,000 Elmore Bolling College Scholarship for Calhoun and Central High seniors in Lowndes County; apply by March 29.

item.title: Tax-free weekend prepares residents for severe weather
item.description: Alabama’s Severe Weather Preparedness Tax Holiday runs Feb. 20 – 22, offering state tax-free purchases of approved severe weather supplies and generators ahead of spring tornado season.

item.title: Brandon Thomas enters commissioners' race
item.description: White Hall councilman Brandon Thomas joins the district 1 Lowndes County Commission race, challenging incumbent Robert Harris with a platform focused on county workers, roads and community input.

item.title: What's Happening in Lowndes County
item.description: From ServSafe training and mom classes to school bus driver jobs, Pre-K, Head Start, cleanup days and fairs, see key upcoming programs across Lowndes County.

item.title: Faith Community Calendar
item.description: Upcoming faith events: Black History Month program in Fort Deposit and a free wild game supper in Hayneville, plus details on how to share your church event.

item.title: Hope Hull man sentenced in federal court for stealing firearms
item.description: Hope Hull man gets 70 months for ramming into a Montgomery sporting goods store and stealing three firearms from a licensed dealer, federal prosecutors say.

item.title: Jake Hooper graduates Mississippi State
item.description: Lowndesboro’s Jake Hooper earns a Bachelor of Business Administration as Mississippi State lists nearly 1,400 students on its fall 2025 graduation roster, with remarks by President Mark E. Keenum.
